description:
Finds failed DAG runs in a Managed Airflow environment.

Use this tool to find recent DAG run failures, for example to begin troubleshooting.

If the user wants to troubleshoot a specific DAG, provide the DAG ID to get the details of
its last failed run. If the user doesn't know which DAG is failing, or wants to see recent
failures across all DAGs, leave the DAG ID empty; in this case, the tool will return the
last failed DAG run for every DAG in the environment that has at least one failure.
If the response returns more than one DAG run and the user asked for troubleshooting or
explaining the failure, ask the user which DAG run to troubleshoot.

Results are paginated; use `page_size` to control the number of results per page and
`page_token` from a previous response to get the next page. If `page_token` is not present
in the response, there are no more results.

dagId.description: Optional. The Airflow DAG ID. If specified, finds a single failed DAG run of the DAG. If not specified, finds one failed DAG run for each DAG that has such a run.

environment.description: Required. The name of the environment. Format: `projects/{projectId}/locations/{locationId}/environments/{environmentId}`

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of DAG runs to return. The tool may return fewer than this value. If unspecified or set to 0, defaults to 20.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `FindLastFailedDagRuns` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

name: find_last_failed_dag_runs

cloudLoggingFilter.description: Output only. A Cloud Logging filter that can be used to retrieve the logs of this DAG run.

dagId.description: The DAG ID of the DAG whose execution is described by this DAG run.

dataIntervalEnd.description: End of the data interval. Added in version 2.2. If run has been triggered manually, this field is equal to execution_date.

dataIntervalStart.description: Start of the data interval. Added in version 2.2. If run has been triggered manually, this field is equal to execution_date.

endDate.description: Timestamp when the DAG run ended. Set only if the DAG run has finished.

executionDate.description: The logical date and time which the DAG run and its task instances are running for.

name.description: The resource name of the DAG, in the form: "projects/{projectId}/locations/{locationId}/environments/{environmentId}/dags/{dagId}/dagRuns/{dagRunId}".

note.description: The note content of the DAG run. Added in Airflow 2.10.0.

runAfter.description: Timestamp when the DAG run was scheduled to start. Added in Airflow 3.

startDate.description: Timestamp when the DAG run started.

x-google-enum-descriptions: The state of the DAG run is unknown.
The DAG run is being executed.
The DAG run is finished successfully.
The DAG run is finished with an error.
The DAG run is queued for execution.

type.description: DAG run type (how it got created/executed).
x-google-enum-descriptions: The type of the DAG run is unknown.

dagRuns.description: The list of failed DAG runs.

nextPageToken.description: The page token used to query for the next page if one exists.
